description: Delocalize plugin (the GUI runs its own handler, mniNavLocalizationSwitchClick, on the file node, which closes the main form so that SaveChanged writes the plugin and the tables) on a localized Starfield plugin, SFBGS004.esm loaded as OracleLoc.esm (not an official module, so it can be edited): every localized string takes its text from the tables into the plugin and the localized flag is cleared.
